classificationRules: No figure is presented as a current universal worldwide Autograph fee.
Domestic FDD exhibit figures are HISTORICAL_FDD_EXHIBIT until live exhibit/agreement is confirmed for the asset.
Temporary Bonvoy assessment reductions have explicit sunset language.
PIP / systems / design costs are VARIABLE_OR_NEGOTIATED.
Owner-level interpretation language must remain labeled as diligence guidance.

presentationFeeSlots.title: To Join
presentationFeeSlots.body: Application $100,000 new-to-system / conversion (+ $400/key over 250); existing Autograph or managed-to-franchise path greater of $150,000 or $500/key; PIP / brand assessment and systems install are separate (confirm current FDD exhibits). Design, market study, and F&B concept costs vary by conversion vs new-build

presentationFeeSlots.title: To Operate
presentationFeeSlots.body: Steady-state 5% monthly royalty on gross rooms sales; Program Services Contribution (~2.02% of GRS plus fixed annual and per-key components—confirm current exhibit); Marriott Bonvoy loyalty assessment on eligible member revenue (public FDD cites ~4.2%, with disclosed temporary reduction to 4.0% through 2027—confirm live exhibit); model owner economics after loyalty chargebacks and distribution—not headline RevPAR

presentationFeeSlots.title: When Things Change
presentationFeeSlots.body: Renewal PIP; conversion PIP revisions; transfer / change-of-ownership fees; termination-related obligations; owner-funded reserves—triggered at renewal, repositioning, or exit, not steady-state operations. Confirm liquidated damages and transfer mechanics in the current agreement.

presentationFeeSlots.title: Fee Categories
presentationFeeSlots.body: Autograph Collection fee categories: list each recurring and one-time fee with definition and base from the current FDD / agreement exhibit. Do not collapse them into a single diligence paragraph.

presentationFeeSlots.title: Fee Variability
presentationFeeSlots.body: Initial vs conversion vs existing-Autograph paths differ; program contribution and loyalty assessments may change by year under agreement terms that allow program fee changes. Lock the fee exhibit before IC—never extrapolate from a peer hotel's rumor.

discrepancies.finding: All numeric fee/royalty/program/loyalty assessment figures in the Proposed Economics copy are attributed to the US Domestic FDD (Mar 31, 2025). International / managed / non-US paths may differ materially.
discrepancies.resolutionRequiredBeforeWriteback: Keep Domestic attribution visible in Presentation; do not strip 'confirm current FDD exhibits' / geography qualifiers. Structured Fee Structure writeback must store source edition + geography.

discrepancies.finding: 4.0% temporary Bonvoy assessment reduction through 2027 is conditional and time-bounded — not a permanent 4.0% rate.
discrepancies.resolutionRequiredBeforeWriteback: Retain sunset language in operate fee body; structured persistence must store both base ~4.2% and temporary 4.0% with end year.
